question: Anong permit at security clearance ang kailangan kapag mag-oorganisa ng fun-run o motorcade sa Davao?
answer: Ang permit at ang security clearance na kailangan kapag mag-oorganisa ng fun-run o motorcade sa Davao ay ang Business Permit (private agency) (organizer) mula sa Business Bureau at ang Security Clearance mula sa Public Safety and Security Office. [S1, S2]

ground_truth: A Special Mayor's Permit is required for events involving groups of people such as concerts, bazaars, fun-runs, and motorcades. General requirements include Public Safety and Security Command Center clearance, organizer business permit, and an Affidavit of Undertaking.
